title: blob_download: peer-fetch timeout up to 300s with no negative cache
description: When a blob is not cached locally and the peer is offline, blob_download_handler waits up to 300 seconds on every download attempt. No negative cache, no circuit breaker. For large files (>18 MiB) the timeout formula yields 300s. Expected user complaint: attachments hang on offline peer. Fix: add a short-TTL (e.g. 30s) negative cache per (mailbox_host, blob_id), or separate the offline-detection phase (5s) from the data-fetch phase.
